chunks: These are the messages of God. We recite them to you in all truth, as indeed you are one of the apostles.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the truthfulness of the Prophet's recitation and his status as a messenger?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Baqarah emphasizes the authenticity of the divine message recited to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), affirming his status as a chosen messenger. In Shia scholarship, this is often linked to the concept of 'Tajwid' in recitation, highlighting the precision and truthfulness of the revelation. The verse serves as a reassurance to the Prophet and the believers of the divine origin and reliability of the Quranic text.
